question: Who has been appointed as the new Chairperson of the New Delhi International Arbitration Centre in December 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Justice Hemant Gupta**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Justice Hemant Gupta** has been appointed as the new Chairperson of the New Delhi International Arbitration Centre in December 2022.
 
• The appointment was made to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of arbitration proceedings in India.
 
• Justice Hemant Gupta is a former judge of the Supreme Court of India, known for his extensive experience and contributions to the legal field.
 
• The New Delhi International Arbitration Centre aims to provide a robust framework for the resolution of international and domestic arbitration disputes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The New Delhi International Arbitration Centre (NDIAC) was established to promote and develop arbitration and conciliation in India.
 
• NDIAC provides facilities for the conduct of arbitration, mediation, and conciliation proceedings and maintains a panel of accredited arbitrators.
 
• Arbitration is a form of alternative dispute resolution where disputes are settled outside the courts by one or more arbitrators.
 
• The establishment of NDIAC aligns with India's goal to become a global hub for arbitration and dispute resolution.
